source_contract.han_stack_2026: Han PRD 113, 084034 / arXiv:2510.26926, Eq. (13)-(14): adjacent stack vertex amplitudes are glued by internal SU(2) Haar integration over half-link holonomies; Schur orthogonality gives d_k delta^{kk'} Tr(H0^{-1} A B H2).
source_contract.toller_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2604.24945 Eq. (13)-(15): Toller T matrices are not SL(2,C) representations, but their Cartan form has ordinary SU(2) Wigner matrices on left/right magnetic-index spaces and T(+)+T(-)=D.
source_contract.causal_vertex_2026: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2601.23162 Eq. (4),(7): the causal gamma-simple vertex uses Toller blocks T_{j m j n}(g_b^{-1}g_a) in the same finite spin-j magnetic-index spaces.
source_contract.scope: This audit tests only fixed-spin SU(2)-Haar boundary gluing / Schur contraction. It does not assert an SL(2,C) representation law for Toller branches and does not test causal-vertex finiteness or complete-stack cutoff removal.

scope_rule: A PASS establishes only formal fixed-spin boundary gluing in the shared SU(2) magnetic-index spaces. It must not be promoted to a proof that Toller branches are SL(2,C) representations, to causal-vertex finiteness, to lambda_f-weighted complete-stack convergence/normalization, to cutoff removal, to same-realization UV-to-IR transport, family terminality, or D7 authorization.
